Stellarium 描述: The Two Guards are the stars β Ursae Minoris and γ Ursae Minoris, traditionally used in desert navigation. Their name comes from an old legend in which al-Jady (Polaris) kills the father of the Seven Sisters—represented by the stars of the Big Dipper—who then carry their father’s bier and circle al-Jady, vowing revenge. Seeking protection from their wrath, al-Jady turned to these two nearby stars, which became known as the “Two Guards.” [1].
Another name for the two stars β Ursae Minoris and γ Ursae Minoris. According to a different version of the legend, these stars are the killers who fled to al-Jady for protection [1].
